name: Triple F Distributing, a Division of Imperial Dade.
old_description: Since 1935, Imperial Dade has delivered critical supplies to our customers. Throughout our history, our customer's success is our highest priority. We create custom solutions that accelerate their business forward.
about:
The business traces its roots to 1935 when Imperial Dade began delivering critical supplies from its headquarters in Kailua-Kona, Hawaii. The company remains rooted in a family-owned legacy built over generations.

Imperial Brady functions as a North American distributor of foodservice packaging, commercial cleaning supplies, janitorial equipment, and industrial packaging. The company sources from more than 1,000 manufacturers, including 3M, Rubbermaid, Tennant, Spartan Chemical, and P&G Pro, and offers equipment sales and service alongside sustainable product options certified by third parties such as BPI, Green Seal, and FSC.

The distributor serves foodservice, healthcare, hospitality, education, grocery, retail, industrial, redistribution, commercial real estate, federal government, and municipal operations. Customers range from independent restaurants and schools to venues such as Ball Arena and federal agencies.

Leadership states the purpose is to help customers thrive by delivering supplies and support with speed, reliability, and expertise, a model shaped by the family-business heritage that prioritizes trust and long-term partnerships.

name: Triplett Companies
old_description: At Triplett Office Solutions, we know that efficiency and inspiration are key elements in creating a productive office environment. That’s why since 1973, we’ve helped hundreds of Iowa businesses maximize their potential by providing innovative office supplies and interior design solutions. Regardless of your company’s size, industry, or budget, we work with you to find solutions that meet your business needs.
about:
Triplett Companies, based in Urbandale, Iowa, has been family-owned and operated since 1973. The business was founded by the Triplett family and began as an office solutions provider for Iowa businesses.

The company operates as a single-source provider of office supplies, furniture (new and lightly-used), interior design services, promotional materials, and printing services. It maintains 6,000-square-foot showrooms in Des Moines featuring products from over 35 manufacturers, and offers free delivery across the Des Moines metro area. In-house printing capabilities cover graphic design through fulfillment management.

Triplett serves hundreds of Iowa businesses of all sizes and industries, supplying office environments with everything from desk accessories to full workspace design. Customers range from small offices to larger organizations seeking integrated procurement, design, and branding support.

The company emphasizes a family-style approach focused on long-term relationships, local community investment, and customer satisfaction as its founding principle. It differentiates itself from corporate chains by keeping jobs and investment within the communities it serves.

name: Tritium Electronics
old_description: . From embedded systems to smart sensors and tools, we understand the process from concept to mass production.
about:
Tritium Electronics operates from Ashland, Ohio, providing embedded systems engineering and manufacturing services for connected products. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in public materials.

The shop combines PCB assembly, CNC machining, and full-box build services. Its floor includes multiple automated assembly lines capable of selective soldering, through-hole and surface-mount placement, wire-terminal and cable assembly, and conformal coating. CNC machining centers produce enclosures from brass, aluminum, steel, stainless steel, titanium, and Delrin. Engineering services cover circuit capture, PCB layout, and obsolescence redesign. The company also manages component procurement and offers an instant online quoting portal.

Tritium serves customers in embedded systems, smart sensors, and connected devices. Referenced clients include Flite Test (unmanned aerial systems), RPC Electronics, Electronics123.com, and Passcode Technologies (access control). The company emphasizes domestic production, noting that hardware is designed and manufactured in the United States.

Tritium positions itself on hassle-free assembly: a web portal for instant quotes, managed procurement, and a controlled production schedule that aims for on-time delivery. It highlights quick-turn first-batch builds and inventory buffering for recurring orders as key differentiators.

name: Troy Industrial Solutions, Maine Fabrication Facility
old_description: Our team specializes in diagnosing and repairing electro-mechanical systems, backed by decades of experience and advanced tools to ensure high-quality service.
about:
Troy Industrial Solutions traces its roots to 1862, when it was established as Troy Belting & Supply Company to provide leather belting and mill supplies to mills, mines, and factories in the northeastern United States. The company operates a fabrication facility in Brewer, Maine, one of four locations across New York, New Hampshire, and Connecticut.

Today the company provides electro-mechanical repair, machining, conveyor belting, and custom metal fabrication from its four Northeast facilities. Its Brewer shop delivers AISC-certified steel fabrication, screw conveyors, and bulk-material-handling systems, while its in-house medium-voltage motor testing center supports predictive maintenance. Services include AC/DC motor rewind, gearbox and pump repair, vertical turbine pump service, CNC machining, precision turning, milling, boring, and 24/7 field service with a fully equipped fleet.

The company serves manufacturing plants, power generation facilities, pulp and paper mills, food and beverage processors, water and wastewater utilities, bulk-material-handling operations, cement and aggregate producers, and steel and heavy industry across New York, New England, and the broader Northeast.

Troy Industrial Solutions differentiates itself with its "we service what we sell" model, combining product supply with repair and fabrication capabilities. Its AISC certification, dedicated medium-voltage motor testing center, and 24/7 emergency response across four locations are cited as key advantages for customers seeking to reduce downtime.

name: Tru Form Metal Products, Inc.
old_description: Tru Form Metal Products, Inc. specializes in forming architectural sheet metal, flashings, gutters, downspouts, standing seam panels and various other metal fabrications. To blend innovative design, function and durability, Tru Form utilizes state-of-the-art computerized equipment that folds metal to the most precise dimensions. Sample pieces can also be made and taken to jobsites for assessment, fine tuning, and approval.
about:
Tru Form Metal Products, Inc. operates from a facility on Grimsby Avenue in Cleveland, Ohio. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders.

The company forms architectural sheet metal into flashings, gutters, downspouts, standing seam panels, wall panels, flush panels, and soffit panels. It uses computerized folding equipment to achieve precise dimensions and also produces sample pieces that can be taken to job sites for evaluation and approval before full production.

Tru Form serves the architectural metalwork and roofing sectors, supplying contractors, architects, and building owners with fabricated metal components, fasteners, tools, accessories, stock sheet metal, drainage products, and safety equipment. Its product line includes roofing tools, drain accessories, and a range of standard and custom fabrications.

The company emphasizes a blend of innovative design, function, and durability, supported by its precision folding technology and the ability to provide physical samples for on‑site verification.

name: Tundra Apparel & Promotions
old_description: Providing quality in quantity to Northeastern Wisconsin and beyond.
about:
Tundra Apparel & Promotions was founded in 2006 in Green Bay, Wisconsin. The company operates from a facility on Ashwaubenon Street and serves customers across Northeastern Wisconsin and beyond.

The shop provides custom decoration services including screen printing, embroidery, applique, heat press, and general customization. An in-house design team prepares artwork for production, and all work is performed on-site by a print crew with more than 20 years of combined experience. The company handles order quantities ranging from single pieces to runs of 1,000 or more, with a standard turnaround of 7 to 10 business days and quotes delivered within 24 hours.

Clients include event organizers such as Gus Macker, corporate accounts like Red Hat, and design firms such as White Design House. The business focuses on decorated apparel and promotional products for a variety of promotional and branding needs.

Tundra emphasizes that every item moves through the full production process in its own facility, eliminating middleman markups. Each piece is inspected before delivery, and the company positions its pricing as competitive because it controls the entire workflow from design to finished goods.

name: Tungsten Parts Wyoming
old_description: U.S.-owned manufacturer of high-density tungsten components - produced powder-to-finish in Laramie, Wyoming, under AS9100D and ISO 9001, with an annual production capacity of 1.6 million kilograms.
about:
Tungsten Parts Wyoming (TPW) is a U.S.-owned tungsten manufacturer based in Laramie, Wyoming, led by CEO Mark Holden. The company operates two production facilities in Laramie, producing high-density tungsten components from powder to finish.

TPW produces tungsten products and custom tungsten components using powder-to-finish processes that include precision finishing, production execution, and first-article inspection. The facilities span 50,000 square feet with 24/7 production capability and an annual capacity of 1.6 million kilograms.

The company serves defense, aerospace, and industrial customers who require dependable supply, repeatable manufacturing outcomes, and parts that meet exact specifications. Engineers and procurement teams rely on TPW for consistent density, predictable delivery, and documentation that withstands program review.

TPW differentiates itself by controlling the full process from powder to finished part, offering cobalt-free chemistry when required, and maintaining compliance with ISO 9001, AS9100D, ITAR, DFARS, and CAGE 842W5. Domestic powder-to-finish production reduces supply-chain risk and provides direct accountability.

name: Turners Ridge Wood Workz
old_description: Discover the beauty of woodworking with our one-of-a-kind, lasting creations—treasures to cherish forever!
about:
Turners Ridge Wood Workz operates from a 2,200-square-foot workshop in La Crosse, Wisconsin. The company was founded in 2019 by David Pehl, who began woodworking as a high‑school hobby in his family garage and later built a backyard shop with his father, Dave. After Dave retired from a 23‑year military career and nearly three decades in law enforcement, he joined David full‑time, making the business a family‑owned, veteran‑supported operation.

The shop produces handmade hardwood cutting boards, custom furniture such as kitchen tables, coffee tables, and end tables, and personalized gift items. Each piece is crafted from hand‑selected domestic and exotic hardwoods chosen for color and grain, then finished to a silky smooth surface. The two‑person team handles everything from design and wood selection to final finishing, with typical lead times of two to four weeks for smaller items and six to eight weeks for furniture.

Turners Ridge serves primarily individual consumers seeking one‑of‑a‑kind gifts, wedding presents, family keepsakes, and custom furniture. The company has also donated pieces for community fundraisers, such as a local theater gala. Orders are taken through an online inquiry form, and the showroom is open weekdays for local customers.

The founders emphasize that every item carries a personal touch—“a bit of our heart and craftsmanship”—and they stand behind each piece with a quality guarantee. The business grew from David’s passion for turning raw wood into lasting, functional art, a mission that continues to drive their focus on unique, heirloom‑quality work.

name: Tutto Ferro
old_description: Since 2001, Tutto Ferro has been crafting high-end metalwork with precision, purpose, and innovation. We design, fabricate, and install architectural elements, custom furniture, and large-scale installations, seamlessly blending steel, concrete, glass, and wood. Whether for homes, businesses, or public spaces, our work is built to endure and make a lasting impact.
about:
Tutto Ferro was founded in 2001 by Paolo Cividino in Reno, Nevada. The company began as a fabrication shop focused on high-end metalwork, blending steel with honed concrete, glass, and wood to create architectural elements, custom furniture, and large-scale installations.

The shop operates a state-of-the-art facility equipped with an OMAX waterjet and a high-definition plasma cutter, enabling precision cutting and shaping of metal. Its capabilities span design and engineering—including concept development, prototyping, material selection, and structural analysis—through custom fabrication of stairs, railings, doors, facades, furniture, sculptures, and public art. The team also handles mixed-media integration, combining metal with concrete, glass, and wood, and provides on-site installation services such as assembly, welding, and placement of structural and decorative pieces.

Tutto Ferro serves architects, designers, urban planners, and private clients across the residential, commercial, and public sectors. Its portfolio includes large-scale public art installations throughout Nevada and custom metalwork for high-end homes in the Pacific Northwest. The company works on both public and private commissions, delivering one-of-a-kind pieces for urban environments, commercial spaces, and luxury residences.

The firm emphasizes collaboration and material fusion as its defining approach, aiming to transform raw materials into lasting works of art that combine beauty, durability, and precision.

name: Twin City Sheet Metal
old_description: Sheet Metal Fabrication Services for Commercial, Industrial and Residential Applications
about:
Twin City Sheet Metal operates from Brewer, Maine, where it was founded in 1951. The company runs a custom sheet metal and steel fabrication shop serving customers across the state.

The shop provides sheet metal fabrication, HVAC ductwork (pre‑fabricated and made‑to‑order), laser cutting, CNC bending and forming, and 3D modeling for design optimization. It works with steel, stainless steel, aluminum, and galvanized steel in thicknesses from 0.021 to 0.25 inches. Equipment includes a Cincinnati CNC 5‑axis press brake with Wilson Tooling, a programmable coil line, a spiral machine, and a nitrogen laser cutter capable of 59″ × 119″ parts. The company handles low‑volume prototypes through high‑volume production runs.

Customers span commercial, industrial, residential, and institutional sectors. Typical projects include ductwork for heating, cooling, and environmental control systems, as well as custom metal parts for a variety of applications. The firm works from initial design through fabrication and installation.

Twin City Sheet Metal emphasizes superior craftsmanship, rapid turnaround, and cost‑effective solutions backed by close customer collaboration. It differentiates itself through exclusive use of Wilson Tooling, a Cincinnati CNC press brake that adjusts after every bend, and in‑house coil line and spiral machinery for duct fabrication.
